scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @platform/api && npm run test -w @platform/deploy
scripts.db:generate: tsc -b packages/shared-types packages/config && npm run db:generate -w @platform/api
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @platform/api
scripts.client:generate: npm run build && npm run openapi -w @platform/api && npm run build
scripts.client:check: npm run client:generate && git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi.json packages/api-client/src/schema.ts
